name: Royal Purple Gala
direction: Create a luxurious royal-purple celebration with deep violet gradients, magenta highlights, metallic champagne-gold trim, elegant confetti, glowing bokeh, and tiny cinematic light particles. Use a symmetrical gold laurel behind the portrait, embossed gold donor-name lettering, and a white ticket card with curved side cutouts and a fine gold border.

name: Emerald Academic Prestige
direction: Create a prestigious academic design in deep emerald, forest green, ivory, and antique gold. Use subtle Thai-inspired line ornament, a refined gold medallion frame behind the portrait, restrained floating sparkles, and a structured ivory information card with clipped corners. The mood is official, trustworthy, warm, and ceremonial.

name: Sapphire Victory Night
direction: Create an energetic evening-sports celebration using midnight navy, electric sapphire, crisp white, and polished silver with small gold accents. Add sweeping stadium-light beams, subtle motion trails, and fine celebratory particles. Frame the portrait with a sleek circular victory arc and use a modern glass-and-white information card with sharp, confident geometry.

name: Thai Silk Burgundy
direction: Create an elegant Thai ceremonial composition inspired by woven silk, using burgundy, garnet, warm cream, and muted gold. Add extremely subtle traditional Thai textile geometry in the background, delicate gold filigree around the portrait, and a cream information card with a fine double-line border. Keep the treatment contemporary and uncluttered rather than ornate.

name: Sunrise of Gratitude
direction: Create a warm uplifting sunrise atmosphere with coral, peach, amber, soft rose, and luminous cream. Use gentle radial light, translucent layered arcs, sparse golden dust, and a halo-like frame behind the portrait. Style the donor name with warm foil accents and use a softly rounded cream information card that feels optimistic and heartfelt.

name: Modern Minimal Ivory
direction: Create a refined editorial-minimal poster with warm ivory, charcoal, muted taupe, and a small amount of brushed gold. Use generous negative space, a precise grid, thin rules, restrained geometric framing, and almost no particles. Present the portrait as a clean premium cutout and the information card as a crisp architectural panel with subtle depth.

name: Crimson Champion
direction: Create a bold championship design in deep crimson, black cherry, bright white, and trophy gold. Add dynamic diagonal ribbons, controlled speed lines, subtle stadium haze, and compact celebratory sparks. Use a strong crest-like frame behind the portrait and a high-contrast white information card with assertive angled details.

name: Celestial Blue Gratitude
direction: Create a calm celestial celebration in deep indigo, sky blue, pearl white, and soft gold. Add a sophisticated star-field texture, fine orbit lines, glowing points, and a radiant circular frame behind the portrait. Keep all celestial elements abstract and elegant, with a pearl information card and delicate luminous edging.

name: Rose Gold Appreciation
direction: Create a graceful contemporary design using dusty rose, mauve, cream, and metallic rose gold. Add translucent petal-like shapes, soft lens glow, and fine rose-gold confetti without making the poster overly feminine. Use a flowing oval portrait frame and a cream card with elegant rose-gold edge detailing.

name: Teal Community Spirit
direction: Create a fresh community-focused design in deep teal, turquoise, sea green, white, and warm gold. Use overlapping translucent waves, subtle circular connection motifs, and soft aquatic light gradients. Frame the portrait with balanced curved ribbons and use a bright information card with rounded corners and a slim teal-and-gold border.

name: Golden Heritage
direction: Create a dignified heritage-inspired poster in rich black, warm parchment, bronze, and luminous gold. Use restrained Thai architectural line motifs, a ceremonial arch behind the portrait, gentle engraved textures, and sparse gold dust. The information card should resemble premium stationery with a parchment-white surface and refined ornamental corners.

name: Fresh Green Field
direction: Create a bright sports-field celebration with deep grass green, lime highlights, white, and sunny gold. Use abstract field markings, layered sweeping curves, fresh daylight, and small celebratory streamers. Place a clean victory-ring frame behind the portrait and use a bright white card with energetic rounded geometry.

name: Festival Lantern Glow
direction: Create a festive evening design with plum, deep navy, glowing amber, and gold. Use abstract lantern-like light shapes, warm suspended bokeh, delicate paper-texture accents, and gentle pools of light. Surround the portrait with a warm illuminated arch and use a creamy card with softly glowing edges, keeping the overall result official and polished.

name: Silver Future Academy
direction: Create a forward-looking academic design in graphite, cool navy, silver, ice blue, and white. Use precise luminous lines, subtle layered grids, translucent panels, and restrained technology-inspired geometry without sci-fi symbols. Frame the portrait with a sleek silver arc and use a clean frosted-white information card.

name: Watercolor Celebration
direction: Create an artistic yet official design with controlled watercolor washes in violet, cobalt, turquoise, and warm gold over a clean ivory base. Keep paint textures around the outer edges and away from all text. Use a soft painted circular frame behind the realistic portrait and a solid ivory information card for perfect readability.

name: Paper Cut Sports Fest
direction: Create a sophisticated layered-paper aesthetic in purple, blue, magenta, white, and gold. Build depth with clean paper-cut curves, folded ribbon shapes, and subtle realistic shadows while keeping the donor portrait fully photographic. Use a layered circular frame and a raised white information card with neatly cut decorative edges.

name: Art Deco Honor
direction: Create a glamorous Art Deco appreciation poster in black, deep purple, ivory, and metallic gold. Use symmetrical fan geometry, stepped borders, fine sunburst lines, and restrained sparkle. Place the portrait within an elegant geometric arch and style the information card with a crisp ivory surface and disciplined gold linework.

name: Blue and Gold University
direction: Create a classic institutional design in royal blue, navy, white, and warm gold. Use formal banner shapes, subtle seal-inspired circles without inventing a logo, crisp borders, and restrained celebratory confetti. Frame the portrait with a dignified laurel-and-ribbon motif and use a structured white information card.

name: Tropical Thai Morning
direction: Create a fresh Thai morning atmosphere with jade, turquoise, pale sky blue, warm sunlight, and gold. Use elegant abstract leaf silhouettes and soft sun rays around the edges, avoiding literal scenery that competes with the content. Use a delicate botanical oval behind the portrait and a clean cream information card with fine gold edging.

name: Magenta Energy Wave
direction: Create a vibrant modern celebration with deep violet, vivid magenta, coral highlights, white, and metallic gold. Use flowing energy ribbons, controlled light streaks, layered gradients, and sparse confetti to suggest momentum. Frame the portrait with a dynamic luminous loop and use a bold white card with smooth sculpted side details.
